format: finale-march-v1 (gzip; little-endian arrays listed in layout; quantization in q)
jobs_method: share gone = women's share of the job x 45.1% + men's share x 16.9% (national rates; assumes workers are survivors at the same rate as all adults of their sex). National; states differ.

road.rule: a stretch is 'taken' (closed to cars) for the hours when walker flow reaches 4,500 people per hour per metre of usable width (FHWA); hours = people that day / (4,500 x width).
